name: PODS
notes: Researched from public pods.com billing, FAQ and cancellation pages and the MyPODS log-in page (no sign-in). Log in is email first, then password or PIN (two-step), or Continue with Google. Monthly container rent recurs on each container's delivery anniversary until it is emptied and returned; charges follow each service and cannot be split into smaller payments (payment_arrangement unsupported). Pay online: MyPODS > Billing > Make Payment. Accepted: major credit cards (ACH is mentioned only as not accepted in Canada), so billing.methods keeps the family default. Autopay charges the card on file when an invoice is due, but is set up by an associate through chat or Customer Care, so autopay is unsupported as self-service. Cancellation is by chat or phone (855-706-4758) only, not email; free until 4 p.m. local time three days before first delivery, then a $150 late-cancellation fee. No late fee, paperless toggle or guest pay is published. Fixer 2026-10-10 (audit storage-funeral): billing.fullBalanceOnly set (charges cannot be split into smaller payments).

autopay.note: PODS turns on autopay for you: log in to MyPODS and chat with an associate, or call Customer Care at (855) 706-4758.

autopay_cancel.note: Autopay changes are handled by a PODS associate through MyPODS chat or Customer Care at (855) 706-4758.

cancel_service.note: Cancel by chatting with a PODS associate at MyPODS or calling (855) 706-4758; requests by email, social media or voicemail are not accepted.

payment_arrangement.note: PODS bills each service as it happens and payments cannot be split into smaller amounts; financing is offered separately through a lender.

help.title: Check your balance and pay
paragraphs: Log in to MyPODS and tap Billing to see your balance at the top of the page; a balance of $0.00 means you are paid up.
To pay, tap Make Payment next to Unpaid Invoices, choose a payment method and submit. PODS accepts major credit cards.
steps: Log in to MyPODS with your email.
Tap Make Payment near Unpaid Invoices.
Choose a payment method and submit.

help.title: Autopay
paragraphs: With autopay, PODS charges your card automatically when an invoice comes due. To set it up, log in and chat with an associate, who will turn it on for you. The card must be yours or you must be an authorized user.

help.title: How monthly container rent is billed
paragraphs: Each container has its own monthly billing cycle based on its delivery date, and rent continues until the container is emptied and returned. If your pickup falls after the renewal date, call Customer Care at (855) 706-4758 before the renewal date to avoid another month of rent.
A temporary hold is placed on your card one day before a delivery; the actual charge posts the night after the service and the hold drops off within 5 to 7 business days.

help.title: Invoices and statements
paragraphs: Invoices appear in MyPODS the night a service is completed or the next day. For a full breakdown, open Invoices & Documents, choose Custom Statements, pick your dates and select Process Statement.

help.title: Cancelling an order
paragraphs: You can cancel at no cost until 4 p.m. local time at least three days before your first container delivery. Cancelling later costs $150. After delivery, the delivery fee, first month of rent and any Contents Protection are not refunded.
Cancel by chatting with an associate in MyPODS or calling (855) 706-4758. Cancellations sent by email, social media or voicemail are not accepted.

extra.intent: Using PODS' cancellation policy, find the fee for cancelling an order less than three days before the first delivery. Do not make a payment or change anything.
Using PODS' billing help, find what date each container's monthly rent is billed on. Do not make a payment or change anything.

solution.text: Monthly rent is billed on the anniversary of the container's delivery date.
